# Getting help with ProphOS

1. **Read the user guide.** The [wiki](https://github.com/OverSite-CP/ProphOS/wiki) covers every tab, with a
   [Troubleshooting and FAQ](https://github.com/OverSite-CP/ProphOS/wiki/Troubleshooting-and-FAQ) page and the
   [known limitations](https://github.com/OverSite-CP/ProphOS/wiki/Known-Limitations).
2. **Search the issues.** Someone may have asked already.
3. **Open an issue** for a bug, an idea or a how-to question, using the forms. Never attach a
   programme with confidential information.
4. **Report from inside ProphOS:** **Administer › Report an issue…** sends the report straight to
   OverSite with the version filled in. It is not public.
5. **Email** [support@oversitecp.com](mailto:support@oversitecp.com) for anything about your
   account, licence or trial, or anything you would rather not post in public.

Security problems: see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

We read everything. Public issues get a first reply within a few working days.
